decision: DTIF is retired from operational authority. Its source workbooks remain retained read-only migration evidence. Current ARGUS truth is governed by the GitHub canonical registry; legacy DTIF material may re-enter current truth only after current-source reverification and normal ARGUS reconciliation.

wave1_historical_snapshot.source: Previously accepted ARGUS PostgreSQL staging state, re-read from the surviving Supabase ARGUS schema
wave1_historical_snapshot.reason: Wave-1 intentionally preserved legacy current/published labels as stale or unverified where not independently reverified. The later GitHub-first transition explicitly did not claim a fresh database export. Re-promoting these records as current truth would therefore overstate evidence quality.

legacy_class_dispositions.rationale: The Wave-1 records were accepted as migration lineage but their current status remained unverified. Re-enter current canonical state only from current authoritative evidence.

Planned-purchase records were deliberately deferred. A current requirement, budget, procurement-plan, tender or other authoritative trigger must be re-collected before creating/updating current ARGUS state.
Legacy supplier/product relationships were not independently reverified. Rebuild relationship claims from current supplier/OEM evidence before canonical reuse.

Legacy pursuit/budget rows are intake/review material and may contain working assumptions. Re-evaluate against current commercial, communication and procurement evidence before active ARGUS or PX use.

canonical_replacement.rule: Only current, reconciled evidence may update the current overlay. Historical DTIF state is not current truth merely because it was once labelled active, published or planned.

archive_disposition.reactivation_rule: No DTIF runtime reactivation. Recover a claim from retained source evidence only through current ARGUS evidence acquisition, reconciliation and verification.
